Do you want to help deliver high-voltage cable projects? Can you take the technical lead from detailed design through procurement, construction and handover? And do you bring an electrical background and experience with high-voltage installations? Then join COWI and put your expertise to work on Energinet’s projects.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As our project portfolio grows, so does the need for Technical Leads to support the delivery of high-voltage cable installations. We are looking for a Technical Lead to join COWI and work as a Consultant on Energinet’s projects.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Compose of concept design, cost estimates, project program timelines etc.

• Develop detailed designs for cable routes, horizontal directional drilling solutions between two or more substations in collaboration with other disciplines in respect to environmental- landowner issues in the project organisation.

• Perform cable ampacity design and electrical studies with standard software applications

• Develop technical requirements for procurement of supply/installation contracts followed up by tender evaluation and contract negotiations

• Participate in external meetings and manage contact with various stakeholders.

• Contribute to substation projects to ensure that cable installations can be routed to the relevant bays.

• Drive technical project delivery and facilitate construction meetings on site.

• Coordinate factory & site testing, quality assurance documentation and handover.

Your primary workplace for the assignment will be at one of Energinet’s offices in Erritsø or Ballerup. When the tasks allow, you will be able to carry out parts of the work remotely or from other locations. Travel in connection with the projects will also be part of the role.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You take a proactive, collaborative and solution-oriented approach to your work and are comfortable managing several tasks at the same time.

On top of that, you will have:

• An electrical background, for example as an electrical engineer, Installatør or maskinmester.

• Experience with the establishment of high-voltage installations.

• Relevant experience in driving projects forward.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Do you want to lead ICT management and digital delivery on complex civil infrastructure projects? Can you translate contractual and project-specific ICT requirements into clear governance, practical workflows and successful technical implementation? Are you motivated by bringing clients, project management, engineering disciplines and digital specialists together on projects such as bridges, tunnels, marine structures and other major infrastructure? Then this could be the next step in your career.

Lead ICT management from requirements to implementation

As our new ICT expert, you will lead ICT management, digital governance and digital delivery on multidisciplinary civil infrastructure projects. Our work includes bridges, tunnels, marine structures and other major infrastructure, often involving complex interfaces between disciplines, organisations and project phases.

You will advise clients and project organization, translate contractual and project-specific requirements into practical processes and workflows, and drive their technical implementation in collaboration with project management, engineering disciplines and digital specialists.

The position is a project-based leadership role and combines professional leadership of the ICT process, leadership of the project’s digital delivery and client-facing advice.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Lead ICT management and digital delivery through relevant project phases, from mobilisation and planning to execution and handover.

• Advise clients and project management on ICT requirements, BIM processes, information management and digital governance.

• Prepare, maintain and implement project-specific ICT documentation based on Molio’s ICT paradigms, contractual requirements and relevant industry standards.

• Translate requirements into clear roles, responsibilities, workflows, digital deliverables and quality-assurance procedures.

• Establish the project’s digital delivery framework, including model and information requirements, naming conventions, exchange procedures, coordination processes and Common Data Environment structures.

• Drive the technical implementation of ICT requirements together with project management, engineering disciplines, BIM coordinators, Digital Design specialists and other technical contributors.

• Facilitate ICT kick-off meetings, workshops and coordination activities, ensuring that agreed processes are understood and applied across the project organisation.

• Manage interfaces with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, project managers, discipline leads, architects, contractors, and international delivery teams.

• Identify opportunities for project-specific automation and digital improvements and coordinate their implementation with the relevant specialists.

• Contribute lessons learned and proven workflows to the continued development of COWI’s ICT management practices.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you enjoy creating structure and direction together with others. You communicate clearly, build trusted relationships and can align stakeholders with different technical backgrounds, priorities and contractual responsibilities.

You are motivated by turning requirements and strategies into solutions that work in practice. You understand that successful ICT management requires robust governance as well as active involvement in project implementation.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least 7 years of relevant experience within ICT management, BIM management, digital project delivery or a comparable field in the engineering and construction industry.

• Practical experience leading ICT management or digital delivery on multidisciplinary projects.

• Strong knowledge of Molio’s ICT paradigms and practical experience applying them on multidisciplinary projects.

• Knowledge of relevant Danish industry standards and contractual frameworks, including YBL18 and YBB19 where applicable

• Knowledge of relevant global Industry standards such as ISO 19650

• Experience translating client and contractual requirements into practical digital processes, workflows and deliverables.

• Experience driving technical implementation, for example through Common Data Environment structures, coordination workflows, quality-control procedures, data exchanges or automated checking processes.

• A strong understanding of BIM processes, information management, digital collaboration and multidisciplinary coordination.

• General knowledge of relevant digital delivery applications such as Revit, Tekla, OpenRoadsDesign

• Experience with Coordination and Common Data Environment platforms, such as Autodesk Forma (formerly Autodesk Construction Cloud), Navisworks; Bentley Infrastructure Cloud and ProjectWise; and Trimble Connect and Quadri—or comparable systems.

• Strong planning, facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish.

You do not need to be a software developer or perform every technical task yourself. However, you must have sufficient technical understanding to define the project’s needs, involve the right specialists, guide implementation and ensure that the resulting solutions are adopted by the project organisation.

Your professional environment

You will become part of Digital Design within Structures and Digital Engineering. We support the delivery of complex civil infrastructure projects, including bridges, tunnels, marine structures and other major infrastructure.

You will work closely with project management, engineering disciplines and digital specialists to establish consistent digital processes across multidisciplinary projects. You will join a collaborative professional environment where knowledge sharing, technical development and practical project value are closely connected.

The role allows you to influence both individual projects and the continued development of our ICT management practices.

Do you have the motivation to lead people, develop structural engineering, and deliver results through your expertise? Then join COWI as Head of Discipline, Structural Engineering and help build a sustainable and liveable world.

Furthermore, you will be part of a community with other leaders with responsibility for Structural Engineering in Denmark and across boarders. Your work base will be in one of COWI's office locations in the Region of Southern Denmark, with reporting line to Kasper Kammersgaard, Vice President / Head of Engineering Design.

Your key responsibilities

As Head of Discipline, you will be central to our structural engineering field, bringing together people leadership, technical excellence, teamwork, and the delivery of projects with Success. You will together with your peers set the direction for the discipline, translate COWI’s strategy into clear priorities and create the conditions for your team to develop, perform and contribute across projects and geographies.

• Manage, motivate and develop approximately 20 structural engineers across three office locations, while supporting competence development, knowledge sharing and innovation within the discipline.

• Ensure high technical quality and consistency across projects and deliveries, providing technical sparring and specialist input to support project execution.

• Support effective resource planning and improve collaboration across disciplines, business units and regions.

• Help advance business growth and client discussions with project managers and market leads, while encouraging close cooperation with colleagues in India and Lithuania and developing their involvement in projects.

• Work closely with your Structural Head of Discipline peers in Denmark to translate COWI’s strategy into clear priorities and actions for the structural discipline.

Your key qualifications:

We are looking for a leader who combines deep technical insight with people-oriented leadership. You bring the professional credibility to provide direction and challenge when needed, while creating an engaging and collaborative environment where people can perform and grow.

Furthermore, you have:

• A degree in Structural Engineering combined with solid experience within structural engineering, consultancy and project-based environments.

• Experience in designing structures and preparing structural documentation according to SBi-anvisning 271 and BR18 (the Danish Building Regulations), together with a comprehensive understanding of engineering quality, standards and project delivery.

• Extensive leadership experience from leading larger or multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to inspire, engage and develop employees at different career stages.

• A collaborative mindset and communication skills, enabling you to build relationships and work effectively across disciplines, teams and organisational boundaries.

• Experience working with clients and supporting business development, including success in winning and delivering projects.

Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your way but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

 On top of that you have:

• Solid business and commercial understanding combined with line and/or project management experience within the buildings and industry sector

• Minimum 8 years of experience in the design and construction of buildings, with solid knowledge of various type of buildings spanning from office buildings to hospitals to industrial or pharmaceutical buildings.

• Proficient communication skills in both Danish and English, written and spoken

• Proficient in the use of digital tools and quick to adopt new methods and ways of working.

Do you have the technical expertise and leadership experience to lead electrical design delivery on large-scale data centre projects?

As Electrical Lead at COWI, you will take a central technical role in some of our largest and most complex data centre projects. You will lead electrical design teams, act as a key technical interface with clients and partners and can shape how COWI develops and delivers electrical design for data centres across the Nordics and internationally. Data centre work experience specifically with hyperscale projects is a requirement for this position. Your work base will be at one of COWI's offices in either Lyngby, Odense, Vejle, Aarhus or Aalborg based on where you live in Denmark.

Grow COWI’s international data centre business

Data centres are a strategic growth area at COWI, and we are continuing to strengthen our capabilities and position in this market. As Electrical Lead, you will combine technical leadership on major projects with significant influence on how we approach electrical design and develop consistent ways of working across our data centre business.

You will work closely with clients, Senior Project Managers, Project Directors, Design Managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams across different project stages. You will work in an English-speaking environment alongside colleagues across the Nordics and the UK.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Act as the technical electrical lead towards clients, partners and other external stakeholders, translating project requirements into appropriate technical solutions

• Lead electrical design teams on large-scale data centre projects, with overall responsibility for the electrical design delivery.

• Plan and manage the electrical design process, coordinating resources, activities, interfaces and deliverables across project stages and delivery teams.

• Lead the technical development of data centre electrical power systems and technical architecture, covering critical power, MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, redundancy and resilience, as well as ICC, BMS and ELV systems and their interfaces with other technical disciplines.

• Ensure technical quality and consistency of the electrical design, providing senior technical direction and supporting key design decisions and complex interfaces.

• Contribute to the continued development of COWI’s data centre capabilities, helping shape our technical approaches and ways of working across projects and international delivery teams.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

To succeed in this role, you combine strong electrical engineering competence with the ability to lead people and complex technical deliveries. You are comfortable taking technical responsibility in demanding project environments and representing the electrical discipline towards clients and project partners.

You have the technical breadth and engineering judgement to lead the overall electrical design delivery and guide specialists across the wider electrical scope. You communicate clearly, work effectively across disciplines and bring a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to complex engineering challenges.

To be considered for this role, you should have:

• A degree in Electrical Engineering or similar.

• Direct experience from large-scale data centre projects.

• Proven experience leading or taking significant technical responsibility for electrical design and engineering in complex projects.

• Strong understanding of data centre electrical design and sufficient technical breadth to lead the wider electrical scope and its key technical interfaces.

• Experience leading engineers or technical teams, combined with the confidence and communication skills to represent the electrical discipline towards clients and senior project stakeholders.

• Strong communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively in international project teams.

• Familiarity with relevant data centre standards and structured delivery frameworks such as EN 50600, TIA-942, RIBA or equivalent is an advantage.

As a Laboratory Technician in our Product Compatibility Team, you will work at the intersection of laboratory science, product quality and patient safety. You will play a key role in ensuring robust compatibility and insulin pump studies for injectable drug products. Join a collaborative team where quality, structure and good laugh are part of everyday work.

What you’ll bring

• Education as a laboratory technician.

• At least 3 years of experience in laboratory work, preferably within a regulated (GxP) environment.

• The ability to balance hands-on lab tasks with complex administration, and interest in the administrative side of the work.

• A structured, proactive and quality-focused mindset, good communication skills and familiarity with documentation practices and MS Office.

• The ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team culture.

• Flexibility to be in the lab at set times for time-dependent studies, for example in the morning or afternoon.

Useful, but not essential:

Experience with LIMS systems.

What you’ll do

As a Laboratory Technician, you will support compatibility and insulin pump studies and contribute to maintaining high GxP standards across laboratory activities.

You will:

• Perform laboratory tasks for insulin pump and compatibility studies according to approved protocols.

• Monitor, trend and document study data and results, so scientists can rely on them.

• Prepare, review and maintain GxP documentation, including study reports, protocols and SOPs.

• Support laboratory administration, including sample handling, inventory management and training activities.

• Plan your tasks around the timing needs of each study and challenge assumptions when something does not look right.

• Take an active part in team meetings and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Product Compatibility Team, a specialised Competence Centre within Global Manufacturing & Supply. The team is a Competence Centre responsible for evaluating and testing the suitability of use of process aids, primary packaging materials and insulin pumps for our portfolio of injectable drug products. Your day-to-day work will be in close collaboration with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians in the team. The team also works closely with internal stakeholders across Aseptic Manufacturing Science & Technology (AMSAT). The team environment is characterised by strong teamwork, high-quality standards and a shared responsibility for delivering reliable data and documentation.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to own your work and be supported to do it well. You will build your expertise through close work with scientists, hands-on experience with a specialised area of compatibility testing, and a team that improves its ways of working together. Clear expectations and a culture that values good results mean your contribution is seen.

What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 437,600 to DKK 643,200, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are an experienced laboratory technician ready to bring structure, confidence and quality to the studies behind our injectable treatments, apply for the Laboratory Technician – Product Compatibility role by 16 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Helle Damgaard Nielsen, Associate Director at HCAS@novonordisk.com.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. Capgemini’s Global Insights & Data business line is a market leader in data, analytics, and cloud platforms across multiple industries, including financial services, life sciences, consumer products, utilities, and the public sector.

Your Role

As an AI/Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate modern data platforms and data products that enable analytics and AI-driven use cases. Working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, you will deliver scalable, reliable, and compliant data solutions in complex enterprise and regulated environments. You will contribute to developing robust data pipelines and ensuring that data products are production-ready, governed, and aligned with enterprise standards.

In this role you will play a key role in:

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data products that support analytics and AI use cases. You will develop and maintain batch and real-time processing solutions, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and performance across ingestion and transformation layers

• Collaborate with data product owners, AI/ML specialists, and platform teams to support feature engineering, model training, and operationalization of AI solutions, including preparing and transforming data for AI models and ensuring traceability and reproducibility

• Implement data transformations using Python and SQL, apply best practices for incremental and idempotent processing, while ensuring pipelines are observable, testable, and resilient

• Contribute to enterprise standards for data governance, lineage, and compliance while continuously optimizing pipelines and platform performance in collaboration with cross-functional teams

Your profile

• Solid experience (+6 years) as an AI/Data Engineer in enterprise environments, delivering scalable data solutions that support analytics and AI use cases

• Hands-on expertise in building and operating batch and near real-time data pipelines, ensuring reliability, performance, and traceability across the data lifecycle

• Experience with modern data platforms and lakehouse architecture, including tools such as Databricks and Snowflake, and working with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform)

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, combined with strong knowledge of modern data engineering best practices such as incremental processing, data quality validation, observability, metadata management, and lineage

• Experience with data modeling (e.g., Kimball, Data Vault), distributed data formats (e.g., Parquet, Iceberg), and streaming/event-driven architectures, along with strong collaboration and communication skills in governed enterprise settings

What we believe you will enjoy about working here

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you can shape your career, work with a diverse collective of experts, and help leading organizations unlock the value of data and AI responsibly.

At Capgemini, you will:

• Work hands-on with modern cloud, lakehouse, and AI-enabled data platforms

• Build data products and pipelines that power analytics and AI use cases

• Gain exposure to large-scale, regulated, and mission-critical environments

• Be a part of a collaborative culture that values innovation, entrepreneurship, and continuous learning

Application

If you are ready to take the next step in your career, designing, building, and operating modern data platforms and data products, we look forward to receiving your application.

Capital is fundamental to a bank's resilience, profitability and ability to grow. In Capital Exposure Management, you will turn complex regulation, data and risk into clear insights that inform decisions at the heart of Danske Bank. This is a role where your analytical skills and regulatory knowledge translate directly into outcomes that matter.

What you will be doing

You will join a skilled, international team of 16 colleagues across Denmark, Lithuania and Sweden. The team combines deep expertise with a supportive culture built on learning and continuous improvement. You will work closely with business, risk, finance and technology teams, providing analysis and recommendations to both business units and senior management on capital regulation and risk exposures.

More specifically, you will:

• Produce strategic insights on capital regulation, capital consumption and risk exposures

• Run, improve and control monthly capital and REA reporting processes

• Interpret regulatory requirements and support their practical implementation

• Perform ad hoc analyses and deliver clear recommendations to stakeholders and senior management

• Improve and automate processes using tools such as Python and SQL

About you

• Strong knowledge in regulatory capital, credit risk models or process automation

• Ability to translate complex requirements into practical, workable solutions

• Self-directed and analytical approach, taking work from analysis through to implementation

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience with process optimisation and automation; Python and SQL are an advantage

• Master's degree in finance, mathematics, science, programming or a related field

• Professional proficiency in English

What we offer you

You will be part of a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We operate in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time. We welcome colleagues from all backgrounds and cultures.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we would be glad to hear from you. For more information or an informal conversation, please reach out to Karin Vedel Acasio, Head of Capital Exposure Management, at aca@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 23 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Danske Bank's Procurement team is looking for a Senior Commercial & Sourcing Specialist to shape and deliver commercially sound outcomes on strategically significant initiatives. You will work at the centre of our Forward'28 strategy, with real scope to make your mark.

You will join a professional, collegial team within Procurement & Premises, working on initiatives spanning outsourcing, technology sourcing, BPO, partnerships and M&A. Collaborating closely with procurement managers, business leaders, legal and specialist functions, you will bring structure and sound judgement to complex commercial workstreams within major transformation programmes. The team combines high professional standards with an open, supportive atmosphere where good work is noticed.

• Translate business requirements into clear commercial positions and contractual provisions with legal teams

• Analyse pricing, financial models and total cost of ownership to weigh cost, value and risk

• Shape and lead high-stakes supplier negotiations involving complex commercial models and contractual dependencies

• Lead commercial workstreams across programmes with multiple functions, suppliers and interdependent decisions

This role offers meaningful involvement in significant commercial decisions across a varied portfolio of complex group-wide projects. Benefits include a canteen, health insurance, pension and six weeks of holiday per year, within a team that takes the work seriously and enjoys doing it together.

If you have any questions before applying, please contact hiring manager Magnus Jacobsen at magnus.jacobsen@danskebank.dk.

**Bring your engineering expertise to processes that help protect lives every day

**Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges and turning technical insight into lasting improvements?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Drug Substance manufacturing processes and support the introduction of new equipment and technologies.

You will join Material & Sterile Operation, reporting to the Senior Manager, and combine hands-on problem-solving with technical leadership. Your work will help ensure that our processes deliver reliable performance, consistent quality, and GMP compliance.

**Your impact

**As a technical expert for your assigned process areas, you will help develop, optimize, validate, and maintain manufacturing processes throughout their lifecycle. You will challenge existing solutions, identify risks before they affect production, and turn improvement opportunities into practical results.

Working across Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, and Quality, you will also share your expertise and strengthen process understanding across teams.

**What You Will Do

**

• Improve process performance: Lead process design and optimization, address bottlenecks and operational risks, and troubleshoot complex manufacturing challenges to improve efficiency, reliability, and quality.

• Provide expertise in CIP/SIP: Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place systems, improving system design, component selection, and cleaning and sterilization strategies.

• Introduce equipment and technologies: Guide technical activities from specifications and vendor design reviews through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, and validation.

• Support validation and technology transfer: Develop validation strategies, lead and support Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), and drive the transfer of processes into manufacturing or between sites.

• Strengthen compliance: Lead and support deviations, root cause investigations, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments. Represent your technical areas during audits and inspections.
